items.description: This section contains agent frameworks and tools that are useful for data science workflows.

children.title: ADK-Rust
children.description: Production-ready AI agent development kit for Rust with model-agnostic design (Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic), multiple agent types (LLM, Graph, Workflow), MCP support, and built-in telemetry.

children.title: Lumen
children.description: Agent framework for chatting with data, turning natural language into SQL, transformation pipelines and visualizations. Outputs are declarative specs that can be inspected, edited, reopened in a notebook or composed into a dashboard.

children.title: ai-evaluation
children.description: Open-source LLM and agent evaluation framework with 50+ metrics, LLM-as-Judge augmentation, and guardrail scanners (jailbreak, PII, prompt-injection). Useful for scoring RAG outputs, agent trajectories, and function-calling behavior in data-science workflows.

children.title: DeepAlpha
children.description: AI crypto trading framework using LightGBM + XGBoost ensemble with 72 ML features. 70.9% walk-forward validated accuracy on out-of-sample data. Supports Bybit and Binance. MIT licensed, available on PyPI.

children.title: CAJAL
children.description: Local AI agent for generating publication-ready scientific papers with real arXiv citations, IMRaD structure, and tribunal scoring. Runs 100% offline via Ollama with 4B-9B models. MIT licensed. HuggingFace

children.title: Not Human Search
children.description: Search engine for AI agents that indexes 9,000+ AI tools and APIs, scoring each on agentic readiness (llms.txt, OpenAPI, MCP, ai-plugin.json). REST API and MCP server for programmatic tool discovery. GitHub

children.title: Arch Tools
children.description: 61 production-ready AI API tools for data science workflows: code analysis, web scraping, NLP, image generation, crypto data, and search. REST API and MCP protocol support. GitHub

children.title: II-Commons
children.description: Daily-updated skill and CLI for deterministic retrieval across arXiv, PubMed/PMC, and supported US policy corpora.

children.title: Chunk Tuner
children.description: Open-source Python library and MCP server to benchmark document chunking strategies for RAG, score retrieval quality, and recommend configurations for a corpus.

items.description: This section is a collection of packages, tools, algorithms, and other useful items in the data science world.

children.title: datacompy
children.description: DataComPy is a package to compare two Pandas DataFrames.

children.title: jSciPy
children.description: A Java port of SciPy's signal processing module, offering filters, transformations, and other scientific computing utilities.

children.title: me_fasttext
children.description: Memory-efficient FastText variant with exact trie n-gram IDs, structure-aware row sharing, and mmap serving for large-vocabulary NLP.

children.title: torchvista
children.description: Interactive notebook-based tool to visualize the forward pass of any PyTorch model.

children.title: FlexViz
children.description: Python library for interactive, cross-filtered dashboards that stay responsive on 100M+ rows by aggregating with Polars on the server.

children.title: The Data Science Lifecycle Process
children.description: The Data Science Lifecycle Process is a process for taking data science teams from Idea to Value repeatedly and sustainably. The process is documented in this repo

children.title: Data Science Lifecycle Template Repo
children.description: Template repository for data science lifecycle project

children.title: TabGAN
children.description: Synthetic tabular data generation using GANs, Diffusion Models, and LLMs with adversarial filtering and privacy metrics.

children.title: RexMex
children.description: A general purpose recommender metrics library for fair evaluation.

children.title: ChemicalX
children.description: A PyTorch based deep learning library for drug pair scoring.

children.title: FileShot.io
children.description: Secure zero-knowledge encrypted file sharing (AES-256-GCM in-browser). No account required, MIT licensed, self-hostable, optional link expiry.

children.title: PyTorch Geometric Temporal
children.description: Representation learning on dynamic graphs.

children.title: Little Ball of Fur
children.description: A graph sampling library for NetworkX with a Scikit-Learn like API.

children.title: Karate Club
children.description: An unsupervised machine learning extension library for NetworkX with a Scikit-Learn like API.

children.title: ML Workspace
children.description: All-in-one web-based IDE for machine learning and data science. The workspace is deployed as a Docker container and is preloaded with a variety of popular data science libraries (e.g., Tensorflow, PyTorch) and dev tools (e.g., Jupyter, VS Code)

children.title: xonsh shell
children.description: A Python-powered shell that enables integration, management and orchestration of data science libraries mostly written in Python, allowing you to build pipelines, code and command-based workflows. It can also be used as a kernel for Jupyter Notebook.

children.title: steppy
children.description: Lightweight, Python library for fast and reproducible machine learning experimentation. Introduces very simple interface that enables clean machine learning pipeline design.

children.title: steppy-toolkit
children.description: Curated collection of the neural networks, transformers and models that make your machine learning work faster and more effective.

children.title: Pandas GUI
children.description: Pandas GUI

children.title: NuriStat
children.description: Free open-source SPSS alternative — menu-driven desktop statistics (t-tests, ANOVA, regression, survival analysis, ROC) with SPSS .sav import/export

children.title: Polars
children.description: Fast DataFrame library for Rust and Python, designed as a faster alternative to Pandas

children.title: Hydrosphere Mist
children.description: a service for exposing Apache Spark analytics jobs and machine learning models as realtime, batch or reactive web services.

children.title: Nervana's python based Deep Learning Framework
children.description: Intel® Nervana™ reference deep learning framework committed to best performance on all hardware.

children.title: Skale
children.description: High performance distributed data processing in NodeJS

children.title: Intel framework
children.description: Intel® Deep Learning Framework

children.title: Datawrapper
children.description: An open source data visualization platform helping everyone to create simple, correct and embeddable charts. Also at github.com

children.title: FunASR
children.description: Industrial-grade speech recognition toolkit supporting 50+ languages with built-in VAD, punctuation, speaker diarization, and emotion detection. OpenAI-compatible API server included.

children.title: IJulia
children.description: a Julia-language backend combined with the Jupyter interactive environment

children.title: Featuretools
children.description: An open source framework for automated feature engineering written in python

children.title: Optimus
children.description: Cleansing, pre-processing, feature engineering, exploratory data analysis and easy ML with PySpark backend.

children.title: Albumentations
children.description: А fast and framework agnostic image augmentation library that implements a diverse set of augmentation techniques. Supports classification, segmentation, and detection out of the box. Was used to win a number of Deep Learning competitions at Kaggle, Topcoder and those that were a part of the CVPR workshops.

children.title: DVC
children.description: An open-source data science version control system. It helps track, organize and make data science projects reproducible. In its very basic scenario it helps version control and share large data and model files.

children.title: Lambdo
children.description: is a workflow engine that significantly simplifies data analysis by combining in one analysis pipeline (i) feature engineering and machine learning (ii) model training and prediction (iii) table population and column evaluation.

children.title: Feast
children.description: A feature store for the management, discovery, and access of machine learning features. Feast provides a consistent view of feature data for both model training and model serving.

children.title: Polyaxon
children.description: A platform for reproducible and scalable machine learning and deep learning.

children.title: Trains
children.description: Auto-Magical Experiment Manager, Version Control & DevOps for AI

children.title: Hopsworks
children.description: Open-source data-intensive machine learning platform with a feature store. Ingest and manage features for both online (MySQL Cluster) and offline (Apache Hive) access, train and serve models at scale.

children.title: MindsDB
children.description: MindsDB is an Explainable AutoML framework for developers. With MindsDB you can build, train and use state of the art ML models in as simple as one line of code.

children.title: Lightwood
children.description: A Pytorch based framework that breaks down machine learning problems into smaller blocks that can be glued together seamlessly with an objective to build predictive models with one line of code.

children.title: AWS Data Wrangler
children.description: An open-source Python package that extends the power of Pandas library to AWS connecting DataFrames and AWS data related services (Amazon Redshift, AWS Glue, Amazon Athena, Amazon EMR, etc).

children.title: CML
children.description: An open source toolkit for using continuous integration in data science projects. Automatically train and test models in production-like environments with GitHub Actions & GitLab CI, and autogenerate visual reports on pull/merge requests.

children.title: DuckDB
children.description: An in-process SQL OLAP database management system

children.title: Grid Studio
children.description: Grid studio is a web-based spreadsheet application with full integration of the Python programming language.

children.title: Python Data Science Handbook
children.description: Python Data Science Handbook: full text in Jupyter Notebooks

children.title: Shapley
children.description: A data-driven framework to quantify the value of classifiers in a machine learning ensemble.

children.title: Chaos Genius
children.description: ML powered analytics engine for outlier/anomaly detection and root cause analysis

children.title: Towhee
children.description: A Python library that helps you encode your unstructured data into embeddings.

children.title: LineaPy
children.description: Ever been frustrated with cleaning up long, messy Jupyter notebooks? With LineaPy, an open source Python library, it takes as little as two lines of code to transform messy development code into production pipelines.

children.title: envd
children.description: 🏕️ machine learning development environment for data science and AI/ML engineering teams

children.title: MLEM
children.description: 🐶 Version and deploy your ML models following GitOps principles

children.title: cleanlab
children.description: Python library for data-centric AI and automatically detecting various issues in ML datasets

children.title: AutoGluon
children.description: AutoML to easily produce accurate predictions for image, text, tabular, time-series, and multi-modal data

children.title: Comet
children.description: An MLOps platform with experiment tracking, model production management, a model registry, and full data lineage to support your ML workflow from training straight through to production.

children.title: Opik
children.description: Evaluate, test, and ship LLM applications across your dev and production lifecycles.

children.title: teeplot
children.description: Workflow tool to automatically organize data visualization output

children.title: Streamlit
children.description: App framework for Machine Learning and Data Science projects

children.title: Gradio
children.description: Create customizable UI components around machine learning models

children.title: Weights & Biases
children.description: Experiment tracking, dataset versioning, and model management

children.title: DVC
children.description: Open-source version control system for machine learning projects

children.title: Optuna
children.description: Automatic hyperparameter optimization software framework

children.title: Ray Tune
children.description: Scalable hyperparameter tuning library

children.title: Apache Airflow
children.description: Platform to programmatically author, schedule, and monitor workflows

children.title: Prefect
children.description: Workflow management system for modern data stacks

children.title: Kedro
children.description: Open-source Python framework for creating reproducible, maintainable data science code

children.title: Hamilton
children.description: Lightweight library to author and manage reliable data transformations

children.title: SHAP
children.description: Game theoretic approach to explain the output of any machine learning model

children.title: InterpretML
children.description: InterpretML implements the Explainable Boosting Machine (EBM), a modern, fully interpretable machine learning model based on Generalized Additive Models (GAMs). This open-source package also provides visualization tools for EBMs, other glass-box models, and black-box explanations

children.title: LIME
children.description: Explaining the predictions of any machine learning classifier

children.title: flyte
children.description: Workflow automation platform for machine learning

children.title: dbt
children.description: Data build tool

children.title: zasper
children.description: Supercharged IDE for Data Science

children.title: skrub
children.description: A Python library to ease preprocessing and feature engineering for tabular machine learning

children.title: Chinese-Elite
children.description: An open-source project that automatically maps relationship networks by parsing public data using LLMs and visualizes it as an interactive graph.

children.title: Desbordante
children.description: An open-source data profiler specifically focused on discovery and validation of complex patterns, such as numerical association rules, differential dependencies, denial constraints, and more.

children.title: dna-claude-analysis
children.description: Personal genome analysis toolkit with Python scripts analyzing raw DNA data across 17 categories (health risks, ancestry, pharmacogenomics, nutrition, psychology, and more) and generating a terminal-style single-page HTML visualization.

children.title: RunMat
children.description: Fast MATLAB-syntax runtime with automatic CPU/GPU execution and fused array kernels.

children.title: Turbostream
children.description: A terminal UI for experimenting with custom rule engines and selective LLM analysis on real-time data streams, without worrying about streaming infra or backpressure.

children.title: WFGY ProblemMap
children.description: Open source “failure atlas” of 16 recurring issues in LLM and RAG pipelines, with observable symptoms and suggested fixes for data science teams.

children.title: DeepAnalyze
children.description: An agentic LLM for autonomous data science, which can autonomously complete a wide range of data science tasks without human intervention.

children.title: Disco
children.description: Superhuman exploratory data analysis. Finds the feature interactions and subgroup effects in tabular data that LLMs and manual exploration miss — with p-values, effect sizes, and literature citations. Free for public data.

children.title: Crypto Pump Scanner
children.description: AI-powered cryptocurrency trading bot with LSTM neural network (84.6% accuracy). Real-time pump detection, walk-forward validated models, multi-exchange support (Bybit, Binance, OKX, Gate.io). Open source.

children.title: Future AGI
children.description: Open-source platform to simulate, evaluate, trace, guardrail, route, and optimize LLM and AI agent apps in one feedback loop, so agents don't just get monitored, they self-improve. Self-hostable. Apache-2.0.

items.title: The Data Science Toolbox

children.title: FirstData
children.description: The world's most comprehensive authoritative data source knowledge base. 210+ curated sources from governments, international organizations, and research institutions. MCP integration for AI agents. MIT licensed.

children.title: ZipCheckup
children.description: Free ZIP-level environmental safety data for 42,000+ US ZIP codes: water quality, air quality, PFAS contamination, radon, lead, flood risk, and 11 more verticals. Public REST API, npm/PyPI packages, CC BY 4.0.

children.title: BDE Score
children.description: AI-powered multi-market stock analysis with transparent BDE scoring across 73 stocks (US/HK/A-share). EU AI Act Art.50 compliant. MIT license.

children.title: Verified Supplement Evidence
children.description: Evidence-graded dietary-supplement dataset covering dosing, bioavailability by form, drug-nutrient interactions, NHANES deficiency prevalence, FDA FAERS adverse-event signals, and cost-per-effective-dose, with every clinical claim citing a PubMed PMID. CC BY 4.0, DOI 10.57967/hf/9356.

children.title: US Truck-Involved Fatal Crashes (FARS) 2018-2024
children.description: Filtered subset of NHTSA Fatality Analysis Reporting System covering 33,898 fatal crashes involving medium and heavy commercial trucks across all 50 US states, 2018-2024. Includes interactive Vision Zero Report Card comparing 19 cities, reproducible Python pipeline on GitHub, and HuggingFace mirror. Permanent DOI, CC BY 4.0.

children.title: latamdata-py
children.description: Python package for one-line access to 38 open research datasets from Latin America (health, neuroscience, mental health, economics). pip install latamdata-py.

children.title: College ROI Dataset
children.description: Lifetime return-on-investment estimates for ~30K US bachelor's programs across 1,775 institutions, built from FREOPP, IPEDS, and BEA regional price data. 5 CSVs with data dictionary, CC BY 4.0, Zenodo DOI.

children.title: HDD Price Index
children.description: Daily open dataset of the cheapest new internal 3.5" SATA hard-drive price per terabyte (USD/TB) by capacity tier on Amazon US, with a historical time series. CSV, JSON and JSONL, no login, CC BY 4.0.
